summary: Inspect the saved startup context artifact named by the launcher.

help:
Usage: mandates [OPTIONS]

  Inspect the saved startup context artifact named by the launcher.

  Examples:
    st mandates
    st mandates --full
    st --no-compact mandates

Options:
  --full                Print the exact saved rendered context text
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: inspect saved startup context (blocks, token estimates and validated SHA-256)
